  • Method Details

    • passSelPd

      public static void passSelPd(int SPdIndex, Product selPd)
      This method receives the data from the Main screen. The product selected in the Main screen is sent to the fields in this method.

    • initialize

      public void initialize(URL url, ResourceBundle resourceBundle)
      This method initializes the fields and top tableView in the Modify Product screen. The fields are initialized with the selected product from the Main screen.
      Specified by:
      initialize in interface javafx.fxml.Initializable

    • onInvPartsSearch3

      public void onInvPartsSearch3(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method searches the Parts list. It calls the lookUpPart method from Inventory Model class, returns a list of matches and searches by Part ID and Name.

    • onAddAssocPt2

      public void onAddAssocPt2(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method adds a part to the associated parts list. It copies a part from the top tableView and adds it to the bottom tableView. It also has an Alert message to make sure a part is selected.

    • onRemoveAssocPrt2

      public void onRemoveAssocPrt2(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method removes a part from the associated parts list. It permanently deletes the selected part from the associated parts list and displays an Alert message to confirm deletion.

    • onSaveMod2

      public void onSaveMod2(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException
      This method saves a modified product to the all products list. It saves the data from the text fields, creates a Product object, links the associated parts list to this object, and redirects to the main screen.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • backToMainAgain

      public void backToMainAgain(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException
      This method is called when the Cancel button is clicked. It cancels the modify product request and redirects to the main screen.
      Throws:
      IOException
